subject: general
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The CEO demanded that the report is submitted (1)/ to the board (2)/ not later than Wednesday afternoon (3)/ for immediate evaluation. (4)/
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb **"demanded"** is followed by a **subjunctive clause**.
 
• In such constructions, we use the **base form of the verb** (without "is/was").
 
• Therefore, **"is submitted"** is incorrect a
